title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Billing Desk Note — Fee Credit Allowances
content:
Two figures of the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service limit fee credits: how many goodwill credits an employer may receive and how long after a fee a credit may be asked for.

| Tier | Goodwill fee credits allowed in any rolling 365 days | Calendar days after a fee within which a credit may be asked |
|---|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 0 | 30 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 0 | 30 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 1 | 60 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 1 | 60 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 2 | 90 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 3 | 90 |

- **Courtesy fee credits** — goodwill fee credits allowed in any rolling 365 days (count).
- **Fee credit request window** — calendar days after a fee within which the employer may ask for a credit (days).

Starter and Core allow no goodwill credit at all; the allowance is 1 on Growth and Pro, 2 on Scale and 3 on Enterprise.
